root_idea.summary: The root centers on the tongue protruding and panting under thirst, especially the characteristic lolling of an animal's tongue.
root_idea.development: The concrete image of thirst-driven tongue protrusion extends to the heat or vehemence of thirst, panting and fatigue, and some figurative or specialized lexical uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form لَهِثَ rather than the imperfect QAC lemma.

senses.definition: To pant, with the tongue lolling out from thirst.
senses.usage_conditions: In 7:176, the imperfect is repeated in the comparison of the dog whether driven off or left alone; the Quran-focused explanation specifically describes protruding the tongue from thirst.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verbal state of thirst, distinct from the action of protruding the tongue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pant or protrude the tongue because of fatigue or weariness; to be fatigued or weary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe the breath rising or the resulting condition of a person or animal when fatigued.
A noun denoting the state of thirst.
A noun denoting fatigue, separately attested from the noun's meaning of thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A red speck seen in a palm-leaf when it is split; plural, such specks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use concerning the interior of split palm-leaves.
An adjective; the feminine form لَهْثَى is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The burning heat, intensity, or vehemence of thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun emphasizing the severity of thirst rather than merely the state of being thirsty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The severity or vehemence of death.
A man having many red moles or spots on his face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative-derived description connected with the red specks found in palm-leaves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Makers of palm-leaf baskets of the kind called دَوَاخِلُّ, in which dates are placed.
A cause or occasion of panting or thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested especially in the phrase فِي سَكْرَةٍ مَلْهَثَةٌ, describing an intoxication that induces such a state.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit's meaning of thirst or being thirsty is represented separately from the Quranic tongue-protrusion use.
Its thirst-driven tongue action is Quran-attested; its fatigue-driven panting and weariness are separately represented.
Specialized meaning of a red speck in a palm-leaf.
Plural form and plural meaning are covered by the red-speck entry.
Meaning of the heat or vehemence of thirst.
Figurative meaning concerning the severity of death.
Specialized description of a man with many facial red moles or spots.
Constructional noun meaning a cause or occasion of panting or thirst.

cautions: The Quranic evidence consists of two active imperfect Form I occurrences in 7:176; the normalized public headword is the standard perfect citation form لَهِثَ.
The Lane material contains several distinct vocalized headwords and specialized derivatives, which are kept separate from the Quranic verb.
